description: Admin-managed catalog of redeemable POS loyalty rewards (e.g. '$20 discount = 200 points', or a free product for a fixed point cost). Redemptions (posRewardRedemptions) reference a catalog row by id at redemption time and denormalize the point cost onto the redemption row, so a later catalog edit never rewrites past redemption history.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Display name of the reward, e.g. '$20 de descuento' or 'Lavado Básico gratis'.

fields.name: rewardType
fields.description: Allowed values: discount_fixed (fixed MXN amount off), discount_pct (percentage off), free_product (redeem for a specific product).

fields.name: requiredPoints
fields.description: Points a client must have to redeem this reward.

fields.name: discountValue
fields.description: MXN amount (rewardType=discount_fixed) or percentage 0-100 (rewardType=discount_pct). NULL for free_product.

fields.name: freeProductId
fields.description: Product granted free of charge when rewardType=free_product. NULL otherwise.

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Inactive rewards stay in the catalog for history but cannot be redeemed.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Optional longer explanation shown to the client before redeeming.

relationships.notes: Multi-tenant isolation via companyId — injected automatically by stored procedures.

components.name: PosRewardCatalogListStep
components.description: IonList of catalog rewards with name, requiredPoints, rewardType badge, isActive toggle.

components.name: PosRewardCatalogItemModal
components.description: Create/edit modal: name, rewardType select, requiredPoints, discountValue or freeProductId depending on rewardType, isActive, description.

hints: Simple CRUD table — standard action 1/2/3 (insert/update/delete) is fine; no immutability constraint here (unlike posRewardTransactions).
CHECK: discountValue required when rewardType IN ('discount_fixed','discount_pct'); freeProductId required when rewardType='free_product'.
